after.reason: The stored witnesses contain the generic caste/lineage designation in copied patriarchal biography; neither deploys it as an answer, verdict, test, case handle, or other observable Chan job.

before.reason: One-graph-short prefix of the proper Buddha name 大通智勝佛; the evidence retains 佛 and supplies no independent shorter referent.

after.reason: A stable independently deployed name: masters say 大通智勝遷座而成正覺, ask 喚作大通智勝得麼, command 參大通智勝去, and also use the expanded 大通智勝如來/佛 forms.

before.reason: Internal tail of covered 即心是佛/自心是佛 formulas; initial operators determine the proposition.

after.reason: Complete proposition and stable searchable core across deployed forms including 智者知心是佛, 心心心是佛, 是心是佛, 自心是佛, and 心即是佛.

before.reason: Truncation of 摩訶迦葉, ending inside the proper name and already flagged as a substring of covered parents.
